entities.name: EBP2
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q9V9Z9 from Drosophila melanogaster; 307 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
Probable rRNA-processing protein required for processing of 27S pre-rRNA.
Annotated as RNA-binding and associated with the preribosome large-subunit precursor.
Annotated localization is nucleus and nucleolus; nuclear-periphery association is also reported.
Sequence properties: predicted molecular mass 35.1 kDa, theoretical pI 10.09, and strongly basic net charge at pH 7.
Pfam Ebp2 domain PF05890 detected at residues 47-300 with i-Evalue 1.4e-59.

entities.name: rRNA processing
observations: EBP2 is required for processing of 27S precursor rRNA, contributing to ribosomal large-subunit biogenesis.

entities.name: Large-subunit ribosome biogenesis
observations: EBP2 is associated with the preribosome large-subunit precursor and is implicated in large ribosomal subunit biogenesis.
